common: One complete Python test code block; exact requested import; no implementation/replacement/mocking/introspection of subject.
Collectable nonempty suite; every generated test passes correct reference.
Relevant assertion/expected-exception detection of all three frozen designated mutants, only when reference-valid.
Concrete meaningful assertions for every applicable task category below; names or prose alone do not establish coverage.
Brief requirement-to-input mapping and honest finite-coverage limitations after code.
No unsupported execution/completeness claims; no truncation; no repaired or selected output.
evaluation_notes: Read source and concrete argument values. Equality alone does not establish exact output types; isinstance(x,int) is insufficient for exact built-in int.

For each specified input position/level, require invalid ordinary type and applicable bool/subclass rejection checks with the other arguments valid. For nested sequences check container and element levels.
Type-before-value/shape coverage needs a concrete mixed-invalid witness where both validation classes exist; do not infer every ordering from one witness.

For mutable inputs require before/after comparison around a successful call; nested preservation applies when mutable nested objects can be valid input. Immutable-only inputs do not require vacuous mutation tests.
Relevant mutant failure means a real assertion or required expected exception, not collection/import error, timeout or unrelated crash. Review designated mutant witnesses before credit.
Partial coverage may be recorded for a reference-invalid file but cannot make it strict accepted. Do not award full coverage without concrete evidence.

TR024: ASCII lowercase converted; ASCII uppercase/punctuation/digits retained; empty string; non-ASCII letters unchanged.
Exact str input rejection including subclass; exact built-in str output.
TR025: Empty/single run; multiple runs; repeated value separated by another run stays separate; correct counts and order.
Exact list input and exact str elements including subclasses; invalid container/element types.
Exact list output, exact tuple pairs, exact str labels and exact int counts recursively.
TR038: 00/FF byte boundaries; intermediate value; uppercase/lowercase/mixed ASCII hexadecimal digits.
Wrong lengths and nonhex ASCII rejected ValueError; non-ASCII lookalike/fullwidth digits rejected ValueError.
Nonstr and str-subclass TypeError with validation precedence witness where malformed value possible; exact int return.
TR049: Correct row-major offsets on non-square dimensions, origin and final cell; single-cell grid.
Each of four args exact int: ordinary invalid type, bool, int subclass rejected TypeError.
Zero/negative rows or columns ValueError with other args valid; negative/out-of-range row or column IndexError on valid shape.
Type-before-value and shape-before-bounds concrete mixed-invalid witnesses.
DV008: Empty strings; equal strings; insertion/deletion/substitution; multistep example; literal Unicode and case-sensitive comparison.
Each input exact str including subclass rejection, other input valid; exact int return.
DV004: Empty=0; zero/255 boundaries; ordinary XOR combination; duplicate cancellation.
Exact list and exact int elements, including list/int subclasses and bool rejected TypeError.
Below0/above255 ValueError and mixed invalid type/value precedence witness.
Exact int result; input list not mutated.
DV011: Empty; unordered intervals sorted; disjoint retained; overlapping/nested/touching intervals merged.
Exact list, exact pair tuple shape, exact int endpoints including bool/subclasses; invalid container/element/arity checks.
low>=high ValueError and mixed type/shape/value precedence witness.
Exact list of exact tuples of exact ints recursively; input not mutated.
DV007: Interior up/right/down/left order; corners/edges and thin/single-cell grids; bounds clipping; original cell excluded.
Each of four args exact int, ordinary invalid types/bool/int subclasses TypeError.
Nonpositive shape ValueError; invalid row/column IndexError on valid shape.
Exact built-in returned containers and integer coordinates as required by supplied contract and authored target; check no coordinate/type substitution.
